press-banca-barra: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it over the middle of your chest with your arms straight.
Lower it slowly until it lightly touches your chest at nipple level, then press it up until your arms are straight.
If you lift heavy weights, train with a partner who can help you with the bar.
press-banca-mancuernas: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, your feet on the floor and your shoulder blades squeezed together against the bench.
Start with the dumbbells at the sides of your chest, level with your nipples, with your palms facing your feet.
Press them up until your elbows are straight above your chest and lower them slowly, without bouncing or arching your lower back.
If you train with a partner to help you, ask them to keep their hands close to your wrists, without touching them unless necessary.
press-inclinado-barra: Lie on a bench inclined at about 45 degrees, with your feet on the floor, and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it over your chest with your arms straight.
Lower it under control until it touches your chest and press it up in a straight line until your arms are straight.
press-declinado-barra: Lie on a decline bench, with your head lower than your feet, and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it over your chest with your arms straight and your elbows close to your body.
Lower it slowly to your lower chest and press it back up.
press-banca-multipower: Place a flat bench inside the Smith machine so that the bar is over the middle of your chest.
Lie down, grip the bar at shoulder width and unhook it.
Lower it slowly to your chest and straighten your arms to return to the top.
press-inclinado-multipower: Place a bench inclined at about 45 degrees inside the Smith machine, so that the bar comes down towards your upper chest.
Grip the bar at shoulder width, unhook it and keep your shoulder blades squeezed together against the bench.
Lower it slowly to your upper chest, without bouncing, and press it up until your arms are straight.
press-inclinado-mancuernas: Set the bench to an incline of between 30 and 45 degrees and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the dumbbells at shoulder height, your elbows pointing down and your arms wide.
Press them up, bringing them towards each other over your chest, and lower them slowly to the starting position.
press-inclinado-mancuernas-agarre-neutro: Lie on a bench inclined at about 45 degrees with your back supported and your feet on the floor.
Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other and bring them to the sides of your chest, at shoulder height.
Press them up until your arms are straight and lower them slowly to the sides of your chest.
press-declinado-mancuernas: Lie on a decline bench, with your head lower than your feet and a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise the dumbbells over your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your lower chest and press them back up.
press-mancuerna-un-brazo: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor and your abs tight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and bring it to the side of your chest.
Press it up until your arm is straight, lower it slowly, then repeat with the other arm.
press-suelo-mancuernas: Sit on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and your knees bent, then lie back, resting your upper back and head on the floor.
Hold the dumbbells at chest height with your elbows at between 45 and 75 degrees from your body.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight and lower them slowly until the backs of your arms touch the floor.
press-mancuernas-juntas: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Straighten your arms towards the ceiling with your palms facing each other and the dumbbells pressed together.
Lower them slowly to your chest and press them back up.
press-pecho-maquina: Adjust the seat so that the handles are level with your lower chest and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles, push your chest out and keep your head against the backrest.
Push the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, without locking your elbows, and return slowly.
press-inclinado-maquina: Adjust the machine seat so that the handles are close to your upper chest.
Push the handles slowly until your arms are extended, without locking your elbows.
Pause briefly and return under control to the starting position.
press-declinado-maquina: Adjust the seat so that the handles are close to your lower chest and rest your head, shoulders and glutes against the backrest.
Grip the handles with your palms facing down, slightly wider than shoulder-width, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Push until your arms are extended, without locking your elbows, and return slowly.
press-pecho-polea-un-brazo: Set the cable at shoulder height with a handle attached and stand with your back to the machine, feet hip-width apart.
Grip the handle with one hand, palm facing down, and keep your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Press your feet into the floor, tighten your abs and straighten your arm forward; return slowly and change arms.
aperturas-mancuernas: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, your feet firmly on the floor and your back well supported, without arching it.
Straighten your arms over your chest and bend your elbows slightly.
Open your arms out to the sides in a semicircle, without changing the angle of your elbows, and raise them back over your chest along the same path.
aperturas-inclinadas-mancuernas: Lie on a bench inclined at about 45 degrees with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet on the floor.
Raise the dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing each other and your elbows slightly bent.
Lower them out to the sides in an arc and raise them back along the same path, without changing the bend in your elbows.
aperturas-declinadas-mancuernas: Lie on a decline bench, with your head lower than your body and your feet firmly on the floor.
Bring the dumbbells together above your shoulders with your arms straight and your elbows slightly bent.
Lower them out to the sides in an arc and raise them slowly to the starting position.
apertura-mancuerna-un-brazo: Lie on a flat bench and hold on to the bench with your free hand.
With the dumbbell in your other hand and your arm open out to the side, raise it in an arc to the centre of your chest.
Lower it slowly along the same path, then repeat with the other arm.
contractor-pecho: Adjust the seat so that your arms are parallel to the floor and sit with your back supported and your feet on the floor.
Rest your forearms on the pads or grip the handles.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest until the handles almost touch and return slowly, without letting the weights touch down.
cruce-poleas: Set the cables at shoulder height or slightly higher and take a handle in each hand.
Step forward so that one foot is ahead of the other, with your arms open to the sides and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest, pause briefly and return slowly to the starting position.
cruce-poleas-bajo-alto: Set the cables at the lowest position and take a handle in each hand.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, your knees slightly bent and your arms down, slightly behind your body.
With your elbows slightly bent, raise your hands and bring them together in front of your upper chest; then lower them slowly.
cruce-poleas-alto-bajo: Grip the handles of the cables set high, with your arms open in a Y shape and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands down in an arc until they meet in front of your lower chest.
Raise your arms slowly back along the same path.
aperturas-polea-banco-plano: Place a flat bench between two cable stations and lie on it with your feet firmly on the floor.
Take a handle in each hand, with your palms facing up and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands together over the centre of your chest, pause and lower them slowly to bench height, without lifting your back or hips.
aperturas-polea-banco-inclinado: Place a bench inclined at about 45 degrees between two cable stations and lie on it.
Take a handle in each hand, with your palms facing up and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in an arc over the centre of your chest, pause and lower them slowly along the same arc.
aperturas-polea-sentado: Place a bench with an upright backrest between two cable stations, with the cables set at chest height when you are seated.
Sit with your back supported and grip the handles with your palms facing each other and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest under control, pause briefly and open them slowly.
pullover-mancuerna: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and hold a dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
With your elbows almost straight, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head as far as you can without pain.
Bring it back in an arc to above your chest.
pullover-barra-brazos-flexionados: Lie on a flat bench with your head slightly past the end and your feet on the floor.
Grip the bar with your hands about 35 cm apart and your arms straight over your chest, with your elbows pointing in throughout the exercise.
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head, towards the floor, and raise it slowly back to your chest.
flexion: Place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, with your fingers pointing forward, and straighten your legs so that you rest on your toes.
Tighten your abs, glutes and thighs to keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower yourself with your torso rigid until your chest or chin touches the floor and push up until your elbows are straight.
Do not let your lower back sag or your hips rise.
flexion-pared: Stand facing a wall, an arm’s length away, and place your palms on it at chest height, with your fingers pointing up.
Keeping your back straight and your elbows close to your body, bend your arms slowly to bring yourself closer to the wall.
Push with your arms until they are straight again.
flexion-inclinada: Place your hands on a bench, slightly wider than shoulder-width, and walk your feet back until your body is straight and at an angle.
Tighten your abs and lower your chest until it almost touches the bench, with your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Straighten your arms to return to the top; if you find it hard, use a higher support.
flexion-rodillas: Kneel on the floor and place your hands shoulder-width apart, directly below your shoulders.
Shift your weight forward until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your head and tighten your abs.
Lower your chest towards the floor with your torso firm and push up until your arms are straight, keeping your knees on the floor.
flexion-declinada: Rest your feet on a bench or step and your hands on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your back and neck in a straight line throughout the movement.
Lower yourself slowly until your chest is close to the floor and push up until your arms are straight.
flexion-abierta: Get into a press-up position with your hands wider than your shoulders and your feet together.
Tighten your abs and keep your head in line with your body, without letting your back rise or sag.
Lower your body towards the floor and push up until your arms are straight.
flexion-manos-escalonadas: Get into a press-up position with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your feet hip-width apart.
Move one hand a few centimetres forward and the other slightly outwards, so that they are uneven.
Tighten your thighs and glutes, lower yourself slowly towards the floor and push back up.
flexion-arquero: Get into a press-up position with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Tighten your abs and, as you lower yourself, shift your weight onto one arm, which bends, while the other stays almost straight out to the side.
Push back up, return to the centre and alternate sides, without twisting or shifting your hips.
flexion-explosiva: Get into a plank position with your arms straight and your whole body tense.
Lower your chest slowly towards the floor.
Push up as fast as you can without your hands leaving the floor; if you find it hard, rest on your knees.
flexion-deficit: Get into a press-up position with your hands on a pair of low parallel bars and your feet on the floor.
Lower your body with your elbows close to your sides, letting your chest go below the level of your hands.
Push until your arms are straight again.
flexion-pies-fitball: Press-up with feet on an exercise ball
Rest the tops of your feet and your shins on an exercise ball and your hands on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Push up until your arms are straight and pause to stabilise yourself.
Lower your chest slowly towards the floor and push back up.
flexion-manos-fitball: Press-up with hands on an exercise ball
Get into a press-up position with your hands on either side of the top of an exercise ball, below your shoulders, and your feet on the floor.
Squeeze the ball with your hands to stabilise it and keep your head, torso and legs in line.
Lower yourself slowly towards the ball and push up until your elbows are almost straight, without locking them or letting your lower back sag.
flexion-balon-medicinal: Place both hands on a medicine ball, one on each side, with your shoulders directly above it.
Straighten your legs until your body is straight and tighten your abs, glutes and thighs.
Lower yourself slowly until your chest lightly touches the ball and push up until your elbows are straight; move calmly, because the ball is unstable.
flexion-lastrada: Get into a high plank position with a weight plate resting securely on your upper back.
Keep your body straight from head to heels, with your abs engaged so that your back does not sag.
Lower yourself until your chest almost touches the floor, with your elbows at about 45 degrees, and push through your palms to come up.
flexion-cinta-suspension: Place your feet in the foot cradles of the straps, below the anchor point, and put your hands on the floor directly below your shoulders.
Tighten your abs, glutes and thighs and push up until your elbows are straight, without letting your hips sag or rise and without swinging the straps.
Lower yourself with your torso rigid until your chin or chest lightly touches the floor.
Do not attempt it until you can keep your lower back stable using your abs.
press-pecho-cinta-suspension: Hold the handles with your back to the anchor point, your elbows at chest height and your palms facing down.
Step one foot forward and lean in until the straps are taut, lowering your torso towards your hands with your body straight.
Straighten your elbows to push your body away from your hands and return slowly, without letting your lower back sag.
Do not attempt it until you can keep your lower back stable using your abs.
fondos-paralelas: Stand between the parallel bars, grip them and lift yourself up until your arms are straight.
With your elbows close to your body and your hips straight, lean forward and lower yourself by bending your elbows, so that your chest leads.
Push until your arms are straight again.
aperturas-banda: Tie the band to a sturdy post, take one end in each hand and step forward, with your back to the post, until it is taut.
Open your arms out to the sides at chest height, with your palms facing forward.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest, hold for a moment and return slowly.
aperturas-banda-bajo-alto: Stand with one foot forward and hold the band under your back foot, with one end in each hand.
Start with your arms down in a V shape and your palms facing forward.
Raise your arms in an arc to chest height and return to the low V.
press-pecho-banda: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and pass the band around your back, under your armpits, with one end in each hand.
Bend your elbows and raise them to chest height, with your wrists firm and your palms facing the floor.
Straighten your arms forward without locking your elbows and return slowly to the starting position.
estiramiento-pecho-sentado: Sit up straight, with your back away from the backrest of the chair.
Draw your shoulders back and down, open your arms out wide and gently push your chest forward and up until you feel the stretch.
Hold the position for 5 to 10 seconds.
estiramiento-pecho-marco-puerta: Place your forearm upright against a door frame or a post, with your hand at head height.
Step forward without moving your arm until you feel the stretch in your chest.
Step back and repeat with the other arm.
estiramiento-pecho-pared: Stand side-on to a wall and place your hand on it, with your arm straight at shoulder height.
Turn your body away from your arm until you feel the stretch in your chest, without forcing it.
dominadas: Hang from the bar with your palms facing forward, your thumbs wrapped around it and your arms straight.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulder blades down and back; keep them there throughout the exercise.
Pull your elbows towards the floor, without swinging, until your chin is level with the bar.
Pause briefly and lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully straight.
dominadas-supinas: Grip the bar with your palms facing you and hang with your arms straight.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulder blades down and together before you start.
Pull yourself up by bending your elbows, which travel towards the floor in front of your body, until your chin passes over the bar.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
dominadas-agarre-ancho: Grip the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands clearly wider than your shoulders.
Take a breath, tighten your glutes and abs and draw your shoulder blades down.
Drive your elbows towards the floor and bring your chin up to the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to the starting position.
dominadas-agarre-neutro: Hang from a pair of parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Keep your shoulders down and back and pull your elbows down and back, bringing your chest towards your hands.
Pull up until your chin is level with your hands, pause briefly and lower yourself under control.
dominadas-agarre-estrecho: Grip the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands closer together than shoulder-width.
With your abs firm and your shoulder blades down and back, pull until your chin is level with the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
dominadas-asistidas-banda: Loop a thick resistance band over the bar and put one or both feet, or one knee, in the bottom loop.
Grip the bar, draw your shoulders down and back and do a normal pull-up.
Pull up until your head passes over the bar and lower yourself slowly.
Use a stiffer or softer band to get more or less help.
dominadas-asistidas-maquina: Select the counterweight on the machine: the more counterweight, the less of your own weight you lift.
Get onto the platform and grip the upper handles with your palms facing forward.
Do the pull-up movement: pull until your chin is level with the handles and lower yourself under control.
dominadas-supinas-asistidas-maquina: Select the counterweight on the machine and get onto the platform.
Grip the upper handles with your palms facing you.
Pull until your chin passes over the handles and lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
dominadas-negativas: Stand on a step or jump up slightly so that you start with your chin above the bar.
Grip the bar and draw your shoulders down and back.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully straight; the slower, the harder.
dominada-isometrica: Grip the bar and get into the top position, with your elbows bent and your chin above the bar.
Hold that position with your shoulders down and your body still.
When you finish, lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
dominadas-parciales: Hang from the bar with your palms facing forward and your shoulders down.
Do only half the range: pull up from straight arms to halfway and lower yourself again.
You can also work the top half: start at the top, lower yourself to halfway and pull up again.
dominadas-lastradas: Hang weight from a dip belt fastened securely around your waist.
Do the pull-up with your usual technique: shoulders down and back, elbows towards the floor and chin level with the bar.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
dominadas-arquero: Grip the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands wider than your shoulders.
From a hang, with your abs firm, pull up, bringing your chest towards one hand while the other arm stays almost straight, as if drawing a bow.
Lower yourself under control and repeat towards the other side.
dominadas-maquina-de-escribir: Grip the bar with your palms facing forward, slightly wider than your shoulders, and pull up until your chin passes over it.
At the top, shift your body to one side by straightening one arm while the other stays bent.
Move from side to side without coming down, like the carriage of a typewriter, then lower yourself under control.
dominadas-comando: Grip the bar with one hand palm facing you and the other palm facing away.
Pull up without twisting your torso and bring your head past one side of the bar.
Lower yourself under control and, on the next rep, bring your head past the other side.
front-lever: Raise your straight body until it is horizontal, parallel to the floor.
Hold your body straight and firm in that position and lower yourself under control.
front-lever-agrupado: Hang from the bar and draw your knees up to your chest.
Raise your hips until your torso is horizontal.
Hold the position and lower yourself under control.
dominada-front-lever: Get into a front lever, with your legs straight or, to make it easier, tucked.
From there, pull on the bar, bringing your chest towards it without losing the horizontal position.
Straighten your arms under control to return to the front lever.
ice-cream-maker: Pull up to the top position of a pull-up, with your chest close to the bar.
Push with your shoulders to move your body back until you are in a front lever.
From the front lever, pull back up to the top position of the pull-up.
jalon-al-pecho: Sit on the machine and grip the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
With your chest high and your back straight, squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull the bar towards your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Let the bar back up slowly; do not bring it down behind your neck.
jalon-agarre-estrecho: Grip the pulldown bar with your palms facing forward and your hands closer together than shoulder-width.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar towards your chest with your elbows tucked into your sides.
At the end of the movement, draw your shoulders back and let the bar rise under control.
jalon-supino: Sit upright with your abs firm and grip the bar with your palms facing you, at shoulder width.
Pull the bar to your upper chest with your elbows close to your body.
Let it back up slowly until your arms are straight.
jalon-agarre-neutro: Attach a V-bar to the high cable and sit upright with your abs firm.
Grip the V-bar with your palms facing each other and pull down until it touches your upper chest.
Pause briefly and let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.
jalon-unilateral-cruzado: Sit diagonally on the lat pulldown machine, with only one leg under the thigh pad.
Grip the handle with the arm opposite that leg and pull down, so that the cable crosses in front of your body.
Let it rise slowly, allowing the lat to stretch, and repeat on the other side.
jalon-unilateral-rodilla: Attach a handle to the high cable and kneel on one knee facing it.
Grip the handle with one hand and pull down, bringing your elbow to your side.
jalon-brazos-rectos: Attach a straight bar to the high cable and grip it with your palms facing down, at shoulder width.
Step back, lean your torso forward slightly from the hips and bend your knees a little.
With your arms straight, bring the bar down to your thighs and raise it again under control.
jalon-brazos-rectos-cuerda: Attach a rope to the high cable and hold one end in each hand, with your arms straight out in front.
Without bending your elbows, bring your hands down to your hips.
Raise them slowly back to the starting position.
remo-mancuerna-un-brazo: Rest one knee and the hand on the same side on a bench, with your back flat and the dumbbell hanging in your other hand.
Draw your shoulder blade down and back and pull the dumbbell towards your waist with your elbow close to your body.
Lift it as high as you can without twisting your torso and lower it slowly.
remo-inclinado-mancuernas: With a dumbbell in each hand, bend at the hips until your chest is parallel to the floor and the dumbbells hang below your knees.
With your elbows close to your body, pull both dumbbells towards your hips.
At the top, squeeze your shoulder blades together and down and return under control, without using your torso for momentum.
remo-inclinado-barra: Grip the bar with your palms facing down, slightly wider than your shoulders, and stand up with it in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and lean your torso forward from the hips with your back flat, the bar hanging and your arms straight.
Pull the bar towards your belly button without losing your flat back.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
remo-inclinado-barra-supino: Grip the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lean your torso forward with your knees slightly bent, your back straight and your chest out.
Pull the bar towards your belly button with your elbows close to your sides.
Pause briefly and lower it slowly.
remo-pendlay: Place the bar on the floor and bend over with your back parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull it towards your chest without losing the bent-over position, moving only your arms.
Lower it back to the floor before the next rep.
remo-barra-t: Stand with one foot on each side of the T-bar, with your knees slightly bent and your abs firm.
Take the handles with a close grip and lean your torso forward from the hips until your chest is parallel to the floor.
Pull the bar as high towards your chest as you can, pause briefly and lower it under control.
remo-barra-t-agarre-ancho: Grip the T-bar, which is fixed in place, with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and lean your torso forward, without bringing it parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest out throughout the exercise.
Pull the bar towards your belly button, no higher, and lower it slowly.
remo-meadows: Stand beside the end of a barbell anchored in a landmine attachment, with one foot forward.
Lean your torso forward, grip the bar with your palm facing down and rest your other forearm on your front leg.
Pull towards your back hip, driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blade, with your shoulder down.
Stop when your elbow is level with your torso, lower under control and change sides.
remo-helms: Standing, rest your chest on the end of a bench, at nipple level and with something soft underneath, with your back almost parallel to the floor.
With a dumbbell in each hand, drive your elbows back until you feel your lats fully contracted.
remo-renegado: Get into a press-up position with your hands on two dumbbells.
Do a press-up and, at the top, drive your left elbow back, lifting the dumbbell towards your body.
Return the dumbbell to the floor, do another press-up and row with the other arm.
remo-polea-de-pie-una-mano: Attach a handle to the low cable and stand about 60 cm away from it, with your legs well apart, one in front of the other.
Start with your arm straight and your shoulder forward.
Pull by drawing your shoulder back and bending your elbow, while turning your palm up.
Pause briefly, return slowly and change sides.
remo-polea-alta-una-mano: Attach the handle to the high cable, stand a metre away and grip it with one hand at head height, with your elbow slightly bent.
Step back with the foot on the same side as the pulling hand.
Pull your elbow towards your torso with a slight twist, squeezing your lat.
Return under control and alternate with the other arm.
remo-polea-baja-una-mano: Place a bench in front of the low cable and sit facing it with a handle in one hand.
Pull the handle slowly towards your body, focusing on the lat on that side.
Return by straightening your arm and letting the lat stretch fully.
lanzamiento-balon-medicinal-suelo: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold the ball in front of your chest with both hands.
Bend your hips and knees with your back flat and take the ball back between your legs.
Stand up forcefully onto your toes and bring the ball up over and behind your head.
Throw it hard straight down at the floor, between your feet, bending at the hips again with your abs firm.
estiramiento-dorsal-rodillas-banco: Kneeling lat stretch on a bench
Kneel in front of a bench with your knees hip-width apart.
Lean forward from the hips with your back straight and rest your hands on the bench with your arms straight.
Push your hips back, without letting your head drop, and turn your thumbs up to focus the stretch on your lats.
estiramiento-dorsal-codos-banco: Lat stretch with elbows on a bench
Kneel in front of a bench, just far enough away for your torso to fit between your knees and the bench.
With your back straight, rest your elbows on the bench with your palms together and your hands pointing up.
As you breathe out, lower your chest towards the floor without moving your lower back, bringing your hands towards your shoulders.
Hold the position with your elbows resting on the bench.
encogimientos-barra: Stand with your knees slightly bent and your back upright, and grip the bar with your palms facing down at shoulder width.
Raise your shoulders straight up towards your ears, as high as you can.
Lower them slowly, without rolling them.
encogimientos-mancuernas: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
With your arms straight, raise your shoulders towards your ears.
Hold for a moment at the top and lower them under control.
encogimientos-polea: Set the cable at the lowest position, grip the handle and stand with your back straight and your abs firm.
With your arms straight, raise your shoulders towards your ears.
Hold for an instant and return under control to the starting position.
encogimientos-entre-poleas: Attach a handle to each of two low cables and stand between them with a handle in each hand.
With your arms straight, raise your shoulders using your upper traps.
encogimiento-silverback: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the bar in front of you with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lean your torso forward from the hips with your knees slightly bent and your back straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as if you wanted them to touch, then release them.
encogimientos-sin-peso: Sit or stand with your back straight and your arms relaxed at your sides.
As you breathe in, raise your shoulders firmly towards your ears and hold for a few seconds.
As you breathe out, let them drop gently.
remo-sentado-polea: Sit at the low cable with your feet supported, your knees slightly bent and your back straight, holding the close-grip handle.
Push your chest out and drive your elbows back, close to your ribs, until the handle reaches your abdomen.
Hold for a second and slowly straighten your arms to return.
remo-sentado-polea-agarre-ancho: Sit with your feet on the footrests and grip the bar with your hands wider than shoulder-width.
Pull towards your belly button, no higher, with your elbows close to your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the weight back slowly until your arms are fully straight.
remo-sentado-polea-supino: Sit at the low cable with your back straight and your knees slightly bent, and grip the short bar with your palms facing up and your hands close together.
Push your chest out and pull the bar towards your abdomen with your elbows close to your body.
Return by slowly straightening your arms.
remo-sentado-banda: Sit on the floor with your knees slightly bent and loop the band around the soles of your feet, at the arches.
With your back neutral, pull the band back by bending your elbows, as if rowing.
As you pull, squeeze your shoulder blades together without hunching or arching your back.
Return gently to the starting position.
remo-maquina-sentado: Adjust the seat so that the handles are at shoulder height and the pad lightly touches your chest.
Sit upright, with your abs firm and your shoulder blades down and back, and grip the handles.
Pull by driving your elbows back, close to your body, without leaning back or arching your back.
Pause when your elbows pass your torso and return slowly until your arms are straight.
remo-maquina-una-mano: Set up the machine as for the two-arm row: handles at shoulder height and chest against the pad.
Pull a single handle, driving your elbow back, close to your body, with your torso upright.
Return slowly and repeat with the other arm.
remo-alto-maquina: Adjust the seat so that the handles are at shoulder height and the pad lightly touches your chest.
With your torso upright and your abs firm, pull the handles, flaring your elbows out to the sides at shoulder height.
Stop when your elbows reach the line of your shoulders or slightly further back and pause briefly.
Return slowly, controlling the weight, without leaning back.
remo-alto-maquina-una-mano: Set up the machine as for the high-back row: handles at shoulder height and pad lightly touching your chest.
Pull a single handle with your elbow out at shoulder height, without leaning back.
Return slowly and repeat with the other arm.
remo-alto-polea-sentado: Seated high-back cable row with a wide bar
Sit on a bench facing the cable, with your feet on the floor, your knees bent and your back straight.
Grip the wide bar with your palms facing down.
With your elbows flared wide, pull the bar towards your upper chest and hold for a second.
Slowly straighten your arms to return.
face-pull-polea: Attach a rope to the cable at chest height and step back until you are holding the weight with your arms straight and one foot forward.
Bend your knees slightly and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull the middle of the rope towards your face, slightly upwards, thinking about pulling its ends apart.
Pause with your hands in front of your shoulders and return slowly.
face-pull-banda: Anchor the band at face height and grip it with your arms straight.
Pull, bringing your elbows high and wide towards your face while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the starting position.
remo-alto-inclinado-mancuernas: With a dumbbell in each hand, lean your torso slightly forward.
Pull the dumbbells towards your chest, keeping your elbows as high as you can.
remo-landmine-perpendicular: Anchor a barbell in a landmine attachment and stand so that the bar is perpendicular to you, at your side.
Bend slightly at the hips and grip the bar by the end, next to the plates.
Raise the bar to chest height, so that at the top your arm is parallel to the floor.
Lower it under control and change sides.
remo-pecho-apoyado-mancuernas: Set a bench to about 45 degrees and lie face down on it with your head just above the top edge.
With a dumbbell in each hand, your abs firm and your shoulders in a neutral position, row towards your upper abdomen.
Squeeze your back at the top and lower the dumbbells to the starting position.
remo-invertido: Lie under a fixed bar set at a suitable height and grip it with your arms straight.
Make your body straight from head to heels and draw your shoulder blades back.
Pull until your chest is close to the bar and lower yourself under control.
remo-suspension: Facing the anchor point, hold a handle in each hand with your palms facing each other and your feet one in front of the other.
Lean back with your arms straight at chest height, your abs firm and your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows and pull your body towards your hands with your elbows close to your ribs and your torso rigid.
Lower yourself slowly; for more intensity, lengthen the straps and move further away from the anchor point.
remo-alto-suspension: Set up as for the suspension trainer row, leaning back with your arms straight at chest height.
Pull your body towards your hands, raising your elbows to shoulder height.
Lower yourself slowly with your torso rigid.
elevacion-plano-escapular: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your elbows slightly bent.
With your shoulders relaxed and your shoulder blades back, slowly raise the dumbbells forward and slightly outwards, to roughly shoulder height.
Lower them slowly to the starting position.
protraccion-escapular-tumbado: Lie on your back on a bench with a dumbbell in your hand and your arm pointing at the ceiling, with your elbow straight.
Without bending your elbow, raise the dumbbell using only your shoulder, as far as is comfortable.
Lower your shoulder back onto the bench and repeat; then change arms.
separacion-banda: Hold the band in front of you with both hands, your arms straight at shoulder height and your elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and pull the band apart by opening your arms until it touches or almost touches your chest.
Hold for a moment and return slowly, controlling the tension.
remo-banda-anclada: Anchor the band to a sturdy point, such as a railing, and grip it with your arms straight and the band taut.
Tuck your chin in slightly and bend your elbows to pull the band towards you while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold for three seconds and return slowly.
retraccion-escapular-banda: Anchor one end of the band at shoulder height and put your arm through the loop, with the band at the level of your triceps.
Step back until the band is taut.
Draw your elbow and shoulder back against the resistance of the band, return slowly and, when you finish, change arms.
empaquetado-escapular: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides, tighten your abs and push your chest out.
As you breathe out, draw your shoulder blades down and back without arching your lower back.
Hold the contraction for 5 to 10 seconds and relax.
elevacion-prona-y: Lie face down with your legs straight and your arms overhead in a Y shape, with your palms facing each other.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulder blades down and back.
As you breathe out, raise your arms off the floor, lifting mainly with your shoulders, not your lower back, and hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Relax and lower your arms to the floor.
elevacion-prona-t: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides, forming a T with your body.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulder blades down and back.
Raise your arms off the floor with your palms facing forward, lifting mainly with your shoulders, not your lower back, and hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Relax and lower your arms to the floor.
elevacion-prona-w: Lie face down with your elbows bent and lowered towards your sides, so that your arms form a W.
Squeeze the muscles between your shoulder blades and lift your arms off the floor, without raising your elbows above your body.
Hold for about 5 seconds and lower them.
elevacion-prona-i: Lie face down with your arms straight overhead, in line with your body, and your palms facing each other.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulder blades down and back.
Raise your arms off the floor, lifting mainly with your shoulders, not your lower back, and hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
angel-de-nieve-inverso: Lie face down with your legs straight and your arms stretched out in front, resting on the floor.
Lift both arms and move them slowly out to your sides.
Bring them back to the front with the same control.
angeles-en-pared: Stand with your back against a wall, with your heels, hips, shoulders and the back of your head touching it.
Place your arms against the wall with your elbows bent at a right angle, at shoulder height.
Straighten your arms upwards, sliding them along the wall as in a shoulder press, without lifting your back off it.
Lower your arms back to the starting position.
superman-mariposa: Lie face down and interlace your fingers behind your head.
Lift your head and raise your elbows as high as you can.
elevacion-trap-3: Lean your torso forward with your knees slightly bent and rest one hand on your knee.
Draw the shoulder of the working arm down and back.
Raise that hand above your head, about 15 degrees, without losing the shoulder position, and lower it.
flexion-escapular-pared: Rest your forearms or hands on a wall.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, drawing them back and down.
Then round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as far as you can.
flexion-escapular-cuadrupedia: Get on all fours with your arms straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, drawing them back and down.
Then round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as far as you can.
dominadas-escapulares: Hang from the bar with your arms straight and your body straight.
Without bending your elbows, squeeze your shoulder blades together so that your body rises slightly.
Return slowly to the hanging position.
estiramiento-trapecio-superior: Sit upright looking straight ahead and hold one shoulder down with the opposite hand.
Slowly tilt your head towards the opposite side, without forcing it, until you feel the stretch.
Hold for about 5 seconds and repeat towards the other side.
estiramiento-elevador-escapula: Standing or sitting, put the hand on the side you are going to stretch behind your back.
Turn your head about 45 degrees towards the opposite side and rest your other hand on the back of your head.
Gently bring your head down, without pulling with your hand, until you feel the stretch.
Hold and repeat towards the other side.
estiramiento-nuca: Standing or sitting, with your shoulder blades down and back, slowly lower your chin towards your chest.
To stretch further, place a hand behind your head and press very lightly.
Hold for 15 to 30 seconds and return slowly.
circulos-hombros: Sit or stand with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Gently roll both shoulders, moving only your shoulders, at a calm pace.
Do a few rolls in one direction and then in the other.
press-militar-barra: Stand and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders, resting it on your upper chest.
Tighten your abs and press the bar straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower it under control to your upper chest, always in front of your head.
press-hombros-barra-sentado: Sit on a bench with an almost upright backrest, your back straight and your abs tight.
Grip the bar with your palms facing forward, at shoulder width or slightly wider, and lower it in front of your head to shoulder height.
Press up without locking your elbows, pause and lower under control.
press-hombros-multipower: Place a bench with an almost upright backrest inside the Smith machine and sit with your back supported.
Grip the bar at shoulder width, unhook it and lower it in front of you to chest height.
Press it up without quite locking your elbows and lower it slowly.
press-hombros-mancuernas: Sit on a bench with a backrest, resting your head, shoulders and glutes against it, with your feet on the floor.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height with your palms facing forward and your elbows slightly forward.
Press them overhead until your elbows are straight, bringing them together without letting them clash, and lower them slowly without arching your lower back.
press-hombro-mancuerna-un-brazo: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, your back straight and your abs tight.
Hold a dumbbell with your elbow bent at shoulder height.
Press it straight up until your arm is straight overhead, lower it under control and repeat with the other arm.
press-arnold: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, your elbows bent and your palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your forearms, so that at the end your palms face forward.
Bring the dumbbells together at the top without locking your elbows and lower them, reversing the rotation, to the starting position.
press-hombros-maquina: Adjust the seat so that the handles are at shoulder height or slightly above and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles with your wrists straight, plant your feet and draw your shoulders back and down.
Press up until your elbows are almost straight, without locking them or arching your back.
Lower the handles slowly, controlling the weight instead of letting it drop.
press-hombros-inclinado-mancuernas: Sit on a bench inclined at about 45 degrees with your feet on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with your elbows bent and your arms at shoulder height.
With your abs tight, press the dumbbells up until they meet above your shoulders and lower them slowly.
press-hombros-rotacion: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand in front of your shoulders, with your palms facing each other.
With your back upright, turn your torso to one side and, at the end of the turn, press the dumbbell on that side overhead.
Lower it, turn to the other side and repeat the press with the other arm.
push-press: Stand with the bar resting across the front of your shoulders.
Bend your knees, keeping your torso straight.
Straighten your legs forcefully and use the momentum to press the bar overhead; then lower it under control to your shoulders.
elevaciones-laterales-mancuernas: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand beside your thighs, your palms facing your body and your elbows slightly bent.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulders back and down.
Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows, to shoulder height.
At around 60 to 70 degrees, rotate your arms slightly outwards so that the front end of the dumbbell rises a little, and lower slowly.
elevaciones-laterales-sentado: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your torso leaning slightly forward.
Raise your arms out to the sides, with your elbows slightly bent, to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly without swinging your torso.
elevacion-lateral-polea: Set the cable low or at waist height with a handle attached and stand side-on to the machine.
Grip the handle with your far hand, so that the cable passes in front of your body, with your chest up and your hips level.
Raise your arm out to the side, with your elbow slightly bent, until it is parallel to the floor; pause and lower it slowly.
elevaciones-laterales-maquina: Sit on the machine with the pads resting just above your elbows.
With your elbows bent, push outwards with them to raise the pads to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging your shoulders.
elevacion-lateral-banda: Stand on one end of the band with one foot and hold the other end with the hand on the same side, with your arm hanging and your elbow slightly bent.
Keep your knees soft, your back upright and your abs tight.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, with your wrist firm, and lower it slowly; then change sides.
elevaciones-frontales-mancuernas: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, your palms facing them and your elbows slightly bent.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulders back and down.
Raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height, without arching your back, and lower them slowly.
elevacion-frontal-barra: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, your knees slightly bent and the bar held with your palms facing down.
With your arms straight, raise the bar in front of you to shoulder height.
Hold it for a moment and lower it with the same control.
elevacion-frontal-disco: Stand up straight and hold a weight plate with both hands at the sides, as if they were at three and nine o’clock on a clock face.
With your arms almost straight, raise the plate in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly to the starting position.
elevacion-frontal-polea: Set the cable at the lowest position and stand with your knees slightly bent and your abs tight.
Grip the handle with one hand, palm facing down, and raise your straight arm in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause and lower it slowly, resisting the weight; then change arms.
pajaros-mancuernas: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean your torso forward.
With your elbows slightly bent, raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly, keeping the same bend in your elbows.
pajaros-tumbado-banco: Lie face down on a bench high enough for your arms to hang freely, with your toes on the floor.
Hold the dumbbells with your elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height under control and lower them slowly.
pajaro-tumbado-un-brazo: Lie face down on a high bench, with a dumbbell on the floor beside you and your other hand resting on the floor for stability.
With your arm almost straight and your elbow slightly bent, raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
contractor-inverso: Sit on the pec deck machine facing it.
Grip the handles with your arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Move your arms back, opening them out, without letting your hands drop below shoulder height, and return slowly.
aperturas-inversas-polea: Set two cables at shoulder height or slightly lower and stand between them.
With each hand, grip the handle from the opposite side, so that your arms start crossed in front of your body.
With your back straight, open your arms until they form a straight line, pause and return slowly.
apertura-inversa-polea-un-brazo: Stand side-on to the cable, set at shoulder height, and grip the handle.
With your elbow slightly bent, move your arm out and back in a wide arc.
Keep your torso still, return slowly and then change sides.
pajaro-polea-inclinado: Grip the handle of a low cable and lean your torso forward until it is almost parallel to the floor, with your knees slightly bent.
Rest your free hand on your thigh and let your working arm hang, with your elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is parallel to the floor and lower it slowly; then change arms.
pajaros-polea-sentado: Sit on the edge of a bench between two cables, with your feet on the floor and your chest resting on your thighs.
Grip each handle with the opposite hand and keep your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, pause and lower them under control.
apertura-inversa-rodillas: Kneeling reverse fly with a band or cable
Kneel and hold the handles of a band anchored in front of you, or of a cable, with your arms straight at shoulder height and your palms facing each other.
Tighten your abs and draw your shoulders back and down, without arching your lower back.
Move your straight arms back and down in a wide arc to your hips, rotating them so that your palms face up.
Return slowly to the starting position with your torso upright.
pajaros-banda: Loop the band around a post at chest height and grip it with your arms straight out in front, stepping back until it is taut.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs tight.
Open your arms back until they are in line with your shoulders and return slowly to the front.
remo-deltoides-posterior-mancuernas: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and bend at the hips until your back is almost parallel to the floor, with your arms hanging.
Bend your elbows and raise them out to the sides, with your arms in line with your shoulders, until they are parallel to the floor.
remo-deltoides-posterior-barra: With your knees bent and your back straight, lean your torso forward and grip the bar with a wide grip and your palms facing down.
Keep your chest still and pull the bar towards your chest as far as you can.
Hold it for a moment and lower it under control.
remo-deltoides-posterior-multipower: Set the Smith machine bar at its lowest position and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Lean your torso forward with your back straight until your chest is parallel to the floor and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Raise the bar towards your lower chest by bending and lifting your elbows, hold it for a moment and lower it.
rotacion-externa-mancuerna-tumbado: Lie on your side with a light dumbbell in your top hand and your elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked into your side.
If you wish, place a towel or a piece of clothing between your elbow and your side.
Rotate your shoulder to raise your hand up and out without lifting your elbow, and lower it slowly.
rotacion-externa-polea: Stand side-on to a cable set at waist height and grip the handle with your far hand.
With your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked into your side, gently rotate your forearm outwards, without moving your elbow.
Return slowly, without letting your wrist or elbow rise.
rotacion-interna-polea: Sit side-on next to a low cable and grip the handle with your near hand, with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked into your side.
Bring your forearm towards your abdomen by rotating your shoulder, without moving your elbow or turning your torso.
rotacion-externa-banda: Tie the band to a sturdy post at elbow height and stand side-on to it.
Grip the band with your far hand, with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and your hand in front of your chest.
Rotate your forearm outwards, as in a tennis backhand, without lifting your elbow away from your side, and return slowly.
empuje-isometrico-hombro-pared: Isometric shoulder push against a wall
Stand facing a wall, with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked into your side, and your fist against the wall.
Push your fist forward into the wall, increasing the tension gradually.
Hold the push for 20 to 30 seconds and relax slowly.
flexion-pica: Get into a press-up position, but with your hips raised towards the ceiling, your arms and legs straight and your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Tighten your abs and push the floor away; if you need to in order to keep your back neutral, bend your knees slightly.
Bend your elbows and lower your head towards the floor, bringing your forehead in front of your hands until it is very close to the floor, and push back up.
Do not arch your back, shrug your shoulders or lift your palms off the floor.
flexion-pica-pies-elevados: Rest your feet on a bench or step and your hands on the floor, and raise your hips until you form an inverted V.
Keep your arms straight, your abs firm and your head in line with your back.
Bend your elbows to lower your head towards the floor, in front of your hands, and push back up.
flexion-pino-pared: Get into a handstand with your hands on the floor and your feet resting against a wall.
Hold the handstand position with balance and control.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your head is close to the floor and push until your arms are straight again.
pino-pared: Get into a handstand with your hands on the floor next to a wall, your feet resting against it and your chest facing the wall.
Keep your arms straight and use the wall as support to hold the position.
Come down under control to get out of the handstand.
pino-libre: Get into a handstand without support, with your arms straight.
Push the floor away with your hands and tighten your abs and glutes to hold the position.
flexion-pseudoplancha: Get into a press-up position and shift your body forward until your shoulders are in front of your wrists.
Do the press-up, keeping your shoulders in that forward position throughout the movement.
flexion-hindu: Start in the downward dog pose, with your hands and feet on the floor and your hips high.
Bend your elbows and bring your chest forward, close to the floor, until you end in the cobra pose without resting your legs or torso on the floor.
From the cobra, return along the same path to the starting position.
circulos-brazos: Stand up straight with your arms straight.
Draw wide circles with your arms: in front, down, behind and over your head.
Then change direction: in front, over your head, behind and down.
estiramiento-hombro-cruzado: Bring one arm across the front of your chest.
Hold it with your other arm and keep it there for 5 to 10 seconds.
estiramiento-durmiente: Lie on your side on the shoulder you are going to stretch, with that arm in front at 90 degrees and your elbow bent, so that your fingers point at the ceiling.
With your other hand, gently push your palm towards the floor, without moving your elbow, until you feel a mild stretch at the back of your shoulder; hold for about 10 seconds.
curl-barra: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent, and grip the bar with your palms facing up at shoulder width.
With your elbows close to your body and your chest still, curl the bar towards your shoulders by bending only your elbows.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight, without swinging your hips or back.
curl-barra-z: Stand with your knees slightly bent, grip the EZ bar with your palms facing up and rest it against your thighs.
Without moving your elbows, curl it up to your chest.
Lower it slowly; if you swing, rest your back against a wall or a post.
curl-barra-z-agarre-estrecho: Stand with your abs firm and grip the EZ bar on its innermost part, with your palms facing up and your hands about 10 centimetres apart.
With your arms straight against your thighs and your elbows still, curl the bar towards your chest.
Pause briefly and return slowly to the starting position.
curl-barra-agarre-ancho: Stand with your knees slightly bent and your abs firm, and grip the bar with your palms facing up and your hands as wide apart as is comfortable.
With your arms straight against your thighs and your elbows still, curl the bar towards your chest.
curl-barra-agarre-estrecho: Stand with your knees slightly bent and grip the bar with your palms facing up and your hands about 30 centimetres apart.
With your arms straight against your thighs and your elbows still, curl the bar towards your chest.
Pause briefly and lower it slowly; if you swing, lean against a wall.
curl-barra-una-mano: Grip an unloaded bar in the middle with one hand so that it is balanced; if it is too heavy, use a lighter bar.
With your free hand at your side, curl the bar until your forearm touches your biceps.
Lower it slowly and change arms.
curl-mancuernas: Standing or sitting, hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight at your sides.
With your elbows tucked into your body and your wrists straight, curl the dumbbells up, turning your palms up.
Lower them slowly, without swinging your arms or body.
curl-alterno-mancuernas: Stand with your feet apart and your knees slightly bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight.
Curl one dumbbell towards your shoulder by bending your elbow, without moving your upper arm.
Lower it and repeat with the other arm, without swinging your body.
curl-mancuernas-sentado: Sit on a bench with your feet on the floor and your back straight, with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing each other.
With your arms at your sides, curl the dumbbells up, turning your palms up.
Squeeze your biceps at the top and lower slowly.
curl-fitball: Dumbbell curl seated on an exercise ball
Sit on an exercise ball with your feet planted in front of you and your abs firm, with a dumbbell in each hand.
With your elbows at your sides and your back straight, curl the dumbbells up to your chest.
Pause, squeezing your biceps, and lower them slowly.
curl-inclinado-mancuernas: Set a bench to 45 or 60 degrees and sit with your back supported, a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging.
With your palms facing forward and your arms still, curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Lower them under control, without letting your arms swing.
curl-tumbado-banco: Lie on your back on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging at your sides.
Without moving your elbows, curl the dumbbells up until your forearms are perpendicular to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly until they almost touch the floor.
curl-martillo: Stand with one foot slightly forward, holding the dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing your body.
With your abs firm and your shoulder blades down and back, curl the dumbbells towards the front of your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Lower them slowly until your elbows are straight, without bringing your elbows forward or shrugging your shoulders.
curl-martillo-alterno: Stand with your knees slightly bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell in an arc towards the shoulder on the same side, without turning your wrist.
Lower it under control and repeat with the other arm.
curl-martillo-cruzado: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Without rotating your arm, curl one dumbbell across the front of your body until it touches the opposite shoulder.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
curl-martillo-polea-cuerda: Hold the low cable with both hands, with your palms facing each other and your body straight.
With your elbows still at your sides, bend your arms and raise the weight.
Lower it slowly without fully straightening your arms and without swinging your body.
curl-concentrado: Sit on the end of a bench with your legs apart and a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing forward.
Rest the back of your arm against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder without lifting your arm off your thigh and lower it slowly.
Keep the rest of your body still and, when you finish, change arms.
curl-concentrado-barra: Sit on the end of a bench with your legs apart and lean your torso forward with your back straight.
Grip a barbell with your palms facing up and your hands about 15 centimetres apart, with your elbows against the inside of your thighs.
Curl the bar towards your chest and lower it slowly until it is near the floor, without moving the rest of your body.
curl-predicador-barra: Adjust the seat of the preacher bench so that your arms are level with the pad.
Grip the straight bar or the EZ bar with your palms facing up and rest your straight arms on the pad, with your chest against it.
Without lifting your arms, curl the bar towards your head, pause briefly and lower it slowly until your elbows are straight.
curl-predicador-mancuerna: Adjust the preacher bench so that your arm is level with the pad and grip a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rest your straight arm on the pad; your other hand can rest or support the working elbow from underneath.
Curl the dumbbell towards your head without lifting your arm, lower it slowly and, when you finish, change arms.
curl-predicador-polea: Place a preacher bench in front of the low cable and attach a short bar.
Rest your straight arms on the pad and grip the bar with your palms facing up and your hands about 15 centimetres apart.
Pull the bar towards your head, pause briefly and lower it slowly.
curl-predicador-martillo: Adjust the preacher bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Rest your straight arms on the pad, shoulder-width apart.
Without lifting your arms or elbows, curl the dumbbells towards your head, pause and lower them slowly.
curl-banco-inclinado-de-pie: Standing single-arm curl over an incline bench
Standing behind an incline bench, rest your arm over the top of the backrest, straight down.
Grip a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Without lifting your arm off the bench, curl the dumbbell towards your head, pause, lower it slowly and change arms.
curl-maquina: Adjust the seat so that the centre of your elbow is aligned with the pivot of the machine and rest your arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your wrists straight, your abs firm and your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows to the end of the movement, pause and lower slowly without quite locking your elbows.
Do not lean your torso back to lift the weight.
curl-arana-mancuernas: Set a bench to 45 degrees and lie face down on it, with your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang with a dumbbell in each hand.
Curl the dumbbells towards your head, squeezing your biceps, and lower them under control, without letting your arms swing.
curl-arana-barra: Use a preacher bench from the opposite side to usual: rest your chest on the sloped side of the pad and let your arms hang down the vertical side.
Grip a barbell with your palms facing up and your hands about 15 centimetres apart, with your arms straight.
Curl the bar until your biceps touch your forearms and lower it slowly; start with a light weight.
curl-polea-baja: Attach a short bar to the low cable and stand about 30 to 40 centimetres away, with your knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar with your palms facing up and your hands fairly close together, with your arms straight in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar up to your upper chest by bending only your elbows, pause and return slowly.
curl-polea-una-mano: Attach a D-handle to the low cable and stand side-on to the machine, with your knees slightly bent.
Grip the handle with your palm facing up and lower your hand to your thighs.
Without moving your elbow, curl the handle towards your chest, lower it slowly and change arms.
curl-polea-alta: Attach a D-handle to each high cable and grip them with your palms facing up, standing between the two.
Stretch your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Without moving your elbows, bring your hands towards the sides of your head, squeeze your biceps and return slowly.
curl-tumbado-polea: Attach a short bar to the lowest cable and lie on your back on the floor with your feet towards the machine.
Grip the bar with your palms facing up, your arms straight and your elbows at your sides.
Pull the bar in an arc to your chest, pause and return slowly.
curl-arrastre: Stand holding the dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing forward.
Draw your elbows back as you raise the dumbbells, keeping them close to your torso, up to chest height.
Pause and lower them slowly along the same path.
curl-zottman: Stand holding the dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing forward and your arms close to your torso.
Curl both dumbbells towards your shoulders.
At the top, turn your palms to face down and lower the dumbbells slowly.
At the bottom, turn your palms to face forward again before the next rep.
curl-zottman-predicador: Sit at the preacher bench with a dumbbell in your hand, your palm facing up and your arm straight on the pad.
Curl the dumbbell and, as it nears your chest, rotate your wrist so that your palm faces down.
Pause, return to the starting position and, when you finish, change arms.
curl-invertido-barra: Grip the bar with your palms facing down, at shoulder width, with your arms straight.
With your elbows down and tucked into your sides, curl the bar towards your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Lower it slowly to the starting position, without swinging.
curl-invertido-mancuernas: Stand with your knees slightly bent and your abs firm, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing down.
With your arms at your sides and your elbows still, curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Pause briefly and return to the starting position.
curl-invertido-disco: Stand with your knees slightly bent and hold a weight plate with your palms facing down and your hands at the eleven and one o’clock positions.
With your elbows and arms tucked into your sides, slowly curl the plate towards your head.
Lower it slowly to the starting position.
curl-kettlebell: Stand with your legs slightly apart and grip the kettlebell with both hands, with your arms straight.
Bend your elbows until your hands reach shoulder height, without pushing with your back or body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
curl-kettlebell-una-mano: Stand holding the kettlebell in one hand with your arm straight.
Bend your elbow until your hand reaches shoulder height, without using your back for momentum.
Lower slowly and, when you finish, change hands.
curl-banda: Stand on the middle of the band with one foot and take a handle in each hand with your palms facing up.
With your elbows tucked into your sides, bend your arms and bring your hands towards your shoulders.
Lower your hands slowly to the starting position.
curl-banda-alterno: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart and take a handle in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Curl one handle towards your shoulder while lowering the other, so that your arms move in opposite directions.
Keep your body straight; once you have mastered the movement, you can go faster.
curl-banda-cruzado: Stand on the middle of the band and take a handle in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Curl one handle across the front of your torso towards the opposite shoulder.
Lower it and repeat with the other arm.
curl-banda-una-mano: Stand on the band with the front of your foot and grip the handle with your palm facing up.
With your elbow tucked into your body and your wrist straight and firm, bend your elbow and raise the handle slowly.
Lower it slowly without swinging your arm; for more resistance, move your foot closer to the handle.
estiramiento-biceps-pared: Stand with one arm close to a wall.
Straighten that arm and rest your hand on the wall.
Gently turn your body towards the opposite side, then change arms.
remo-invertido-supino: Lie on your back under a fixed bar set at a suitable height and grip it with your palms facing you.
With your arms straight, your shoulders firm and your body straight from head to feet, bend your elbows.
Pull until your chest is close to the bar and lower yourself under control.
curl-biceps-peso-corporal: Bodyweight biceps curl on a low bar
Stand under a bar at waist or chest height and grip it with your palms facing you, at shoulder width.
Lean back with your arms straight, so that your body is at an angle.
With your elbows high and close to the bar, bend them to bring your torso towards the bar, as in a curl, and lower yourself under control.
curl-suspension: Facing the anchor point, with one foot in front of the other, hold the handles with your palms facing up and your arms straight at chest height.
Lean back with your abs firm, your shoulder blades down and back and your body in line.
Bend your elbows, which stay high and in front, to bring your body towards your hands, and lower yourself slowly.
Only do it if you can keep your lower back stable using your abs.
curl-martillo-suspension: Hold the handles as if they were an extension of the straps, with your palms facing each other.
With your arms straight out in front, lean back with your body completely straight.
Bend your elbows to bring your body towards the straps; at the end, your hands open slightly outwards.
Return slowly to the starting position.
curl-suspension-una-mano: Standing, hold the handles of the straps and lean back with your weight on one arm only, with your spine neutral.
Bend your elbow slowly to raise your body; as you near the end, turn your palm up and squeeze.
Lower yourself slowly and, when you finish, change arms.
curl-suspension-agarre-prono: Suspension trainer curl with an overhand grip
Set up as for the suspension trainer curl, but with your palms facing down.
Lean back with your abs firm and your body in line.
Bend your elbows to bring your body towards your hands and lower yourself slowly.
muscle-up: Hang from the bar and do an explosive pull-up, faster than normal.
When the bar nears your upper chest, quickly flex your wrists to bring your forearms over it.
Lean your body forward and straighten your elbows until the bar is at waist height and your arms are straight.
press-frances-barra-z: Lie on your back on a flat bench and hold the EZ bar with your palms facing your feet and your arms straight above your shoulders.
Without moving your upper arms, bend your elbows and lower the bar towards your forehead.
Just before it touches, straighten your elbows to raise the bar again.
press-frances-barra: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and hold the bar with your palms facing your feet, your arms straight and the bar over your face.
Bend your elbows slowly and lower the bar towards your forehead or slightly behind your head, keeping your upper arms vertical.
Stop just above your forehead, or earlier if your arms drift back, and straighten your elbows slowly to come up.
press-frances-mancuernas: Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms straight above your shoulders.
Without moving your upper arms, bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells in an arc beside your head.
Straighten your elbows to return to the starting position.
extension-triceps-tumbado-una-mancuerna: Lying triceps extension with one dumbbell
Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
Raise it above your body with your arms pointing at the ceiling.
Without moving your upper arms, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head and raise it slowly.
extension-triceps-tumbado-un-brazo: Lie on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in one hand, with your arm straight over your chest.
Cross your free hand over your chest and hold the upper part of the arm with the dumbbell, to support it.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell towards your head, moving only your forearm, return to the top and repeat with the other arm; start with a light weight.
press-frances-inclinado-mancuernas: Lie on your back on a bench inclined at about 45 degrees, with your feet on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand.
Straighten your arms above your shoulders with your palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells behind your head and straighten them again under control.
press-frances-declinado-barra-z: Lie on your back on a decline bench and hold the EZ bar with your arms straight, perpendicular to your chest.
Without moving your elbows from their position, lower the bar towards your head.
Return slowly to the starting position.
press-frances-declinado-mancuernas: Lie on your back on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Straighten your arms perpendicular to your chest and, without moving your elbows from their position, lower the dumbbells until they are close to your head.
Return slowly to the starting position.
press-frances-suelo: Lie on your back on the floor holding the EZ bar with your arms straight above your shoulders.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar behind your head until it rests on the floor.
From there, straighten your elbows to raise it again.
extension-triceps-sobre-cabeza-mancuerna: Stand with your back straight and hold a dumbbell with both hands beneath the top plate.
Raise it above your head and, with your elbows close to your head, lower it in an arc behind you.
Straighten your elbows to raise it again.
extension-triceps-sentado-mancuerna: Sit on a bench, preferably one with a backrest, with your feet firmly on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and straighten your arms above your head.
Lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head and straighten your elbows again.
extension-triceps-un-brazo-mancuerna: Stand with your back straight and a dumbbell in one hand, with your arm straight above your head.
With your elbow close to your head, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind you until it is in line with your spine.
Straighten your elbow to raise it again and repeat with the other arm.
extension-triceps-sobre-cabeza-barra: Stand with your back straight and hold the bar above your head with a close grip.
Keeping your elbows up and close to your head, lower the bar behind you by bending your elbows.
Straighten your elbows to raise it again.
patada-triceps-mancuerna: Stand in a split stance, with the leg opposite the dumbbell in front, rest your free hand on your thigh and lean your torso forward.
Keep the upper arm holding the dumbbell tucked into your body, parallel to your torso, with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Straighten your elbow until your arm is fully extended, without moving your upper arm, and return slowly without twisting or arching your back.
patada-triceps-dos-mancuernas: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body, bend your knees slightly and lean your torso forward until it is almost parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arms tucked into your torso, parallel to the floor, with your forearms pointing down.
Straighten your elbows back without moving your upper arms and return slowly.
patada-triceps-polea: Grip the cable handle with one hand and bring your elbow up and back, slightly above your torso.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor throughout the exercise.
Straighten your elbow and return slowly to the starting position.
patada-triceps-banco-inclinado: Set the bench to about 60 degrees and rest your chest on it, with your body in an almost straight line and a dumbbell in each hand.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together to bring your elbows behind your torso, with your upper arms almost parallel to the floor.
Straighten your elbows until your arms are straight and lower the dumbbells slowly.
extension-triceps-polea-barra: Attach a straight bar to the high cable and stand facing it, with your back upright and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar with both hands and tuck your elbows into your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight and return by bending your elbows, without moving them from their position.
extension-triceps-polea-cuerda: Attach a rope to the high cable and grip it with your palms facing each other, with your torso leaning slightly forward.
With your elbows tucked into your ribs, push the rope down until your arms are straight, pulling the ends apart at the end.
Return slowly without moving your upper arms.
extension-triceps-polea-barra-v: Attach a V-bar to the high cable and grip it with your palms facing down.
Tighten your abs and keep your back straight and your elbows tucked into your sides.
Push the bar towards your thighs, pause and return to the starting position.
extension-triceps-polea-agarre-inverso: Attach a bar to the high cable and grip it with your palms facing up.
With your elbows tucked into your sides, bring the bar towards your thighs by straightening your arms.
Pause and return slowly; if it helps, put one foot forward.
extension-triceps-polea-un-brazo: Attach a handle to the high cable and grip it with one hand, palm facing up.
Keep your back straight, your abs tight and your elbow tucked into your side.
Push down until your arm is straight and return slowly; then change arms.
extension-triceps-polea-sobre-cabeza: Attach a rope to the cable, stand with your back to the machine with one foot forward and lean your torso slightly forward from the hips.
Hold the rope behind your head with your elbows bent.
Straighten your elbows, pulling the ends of the rope apart at the end, and return slowly without losing tension.
extension-triceps-polea-baja-un-brazo: Single-arm low cable overhead triceps extension
Stand with your back to a low cable and grip the handle with one hand behind your body.
